items.description: Electrician labour checking/rewiring flooded circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: Rainwater surface flooding is inundation under 2.1(c2), which is not shown as insured. Under 3.6.1/3.6.2(b) the whole claim is barred, including all trade labour. If it were covered, 12 h at about 75 EUR.
Journey charges are barred under 3.6.2(f) because the inundation peril is uninsured. If covered, the prior is about 79 EUR.
Barred by 3.6.2(d) as the claim is uninsured inundation. Working equipment is also never insured (4.3(d), 5.2.2).
This is working equipment, excluded under 4.3(d) and 7.1.8(b). The whole claim is also barred under 3.6.
Removing standing water is a measure explicitly barred under 3.6.2(d), since inundation (c2) is not recorded as insured.
Materials are barred under 3.6.2(c) because the cause is an uninsured inundation.

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue gas system and storage tank
items.rationale: The plant was damaged by flood or inundation, not by escape of water. Group (c2) is not recorded, so 3.6.2(a) bars replacement of plant.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation work belonging to a replacement is barred under 3.6.2(a) because the peril is uninsured.
Disposal is barred under 3.6.2(e) and (g) because the inundation peril is uninsured.
Barred under 3.6.2(f). Even if the claim were covered, this is a second journey charge, excluded by 7.1.8(d).
